expected_evidence: Commission implementing act for other essential or important entities, if adopted

note: 'May' is the modal verb. 'As necessary' and 'other than those referred to in the first subparagraph' limit this power. Sectoral requirements are named as well as technical and methodological requirements. Absence of an act is consistent with this sentence.

references.law_text:
The Commission may adopt implementing acts laying down the technical and the
methodological requirements, as well as sectoral requirements, as necessary,
of the measures referred to in paragraph 2 with regard to essential and
important entities other than those referred to in the first subparagraph of
this paragraph.

remediation_hint: Look for a Commission implementing act for other essential or important entities only if one was adopted. 'May' is not a duty to adopt an act for every such entity.
scope: the technical and the methodological requirements, as well as sectoral requirements
